values also use Object despite always originating as text.

serialization. Keep date and time fields as strings and parse them only for
display, preserving free-form input while improving type safety.

commitResults.messageTitle: Improve code quality and storage handling
commitResults.messageBody:
Storage parsing mixes validation and task construction in one long method,
while task subclasses duplicate parts of the storage format. Date and time
values also use Object despite always originating as text.

Refactor storage handling into focused operations and centralize common task
serialization. Keep date and time fields as strings and parse them only for
display, preserving free-form input while improving type safety.

Use clearer names, remove unused GUI fields and redundant comments, and add
storage round-trip tests to protect the existing file format.

Several components rely on internal contracts that are not explicit in the
code.

Violations can surface later as less specific exceptions, making programming
mistakes harder to locate.

Add assertions for command routing, task and date-time invariants, and JavaFX
initialization order. Keep recoverable input and storage errors under normal
exception handling.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add duplicate task detection by description
commitResults.messageBody:
Prevent adding tasks with the same description, regardless of task type,
completion status, or scheduling details. Add tests for cross-type and
different-duration duplicates.

commitResults.messageTitle: GUI: Improve chat layout and styling
commitResults.messageBody:
The chat window uses fixed dimensions, plain message labels, and square
avatars. Its controls do not adapt cleanly when the window is resized,
and long messages can stretch the avatar frame.

Improve the responsive layout, present messages as distinct chat bubbles,
and display avatars in fixed-size circular frames. Add consistent styling
so the interface remains readable at different window sizes.

Integrate the responsive chat layout, styled message bubbles, resizable
window, and fixed-size circular avatars into the main application.

commitResults.messageTitle: Harden task input and storage handling
commitResults.messageBody:
Malformed commands and invalid task data can produce confusing responses or
leave saved tasks at risk when loading or writing fails.

Reject missing or repeated parameters, invalid dates and time ranges,
duplicate tasks, and malformed storage records. Accept harmless surrounding
and repeated spaces so valid commands remain convenient to enter.

Protect unreadable or corrupted task files from being overwritten, and save
valid task data atomically. Replace invalid sample records with varied todos,
deadlines, and events for persistence testing.

This makes errors actionable while preserving user data when storage cannot
be trusted.

commitResults.messageTitle: Improve GUI and harden task error handling
commitResults.messageBody:
Improve the responsive chat layout with styled message bubbles, circular
avatars, and controls that adapt when the window is resized.

Handle malformed commands, invalid dates and time ranges, repeated
parameters, duplicate tasks, and corrupted storage records. Protect
unreadable task files from being overwritten and save valid data atomically.

Add regression tests and valid sample task records covering the supported
task types and completion states.

The user guide contains placeholder content and still refers to Duke.
Readers cannot identify the chatbot or learn how to use its important
features.

Replace the placeholders with a guide that identifies Bos and documents
all supported commands, task notation, date formats, storage behavior,
and input restrictions.

This gives readers enough information to use Bos and avoid common input
and task-numbering mistakes.
